title: Uninterested
summary: UNIN'TERESTED, adjective 1. Not interested; not having any interest or property in; having nothing at stake; as, to be uninterested in any business or calamity. 2. Not having the mind or the passions

inlines.v: UNIN'TERESTED, adjective 1. Not interested; not having any interest or property in; having nothing at stake; as, to be uninterested in any business or calamity. 2. Not having the mind or the passions engaged; as, to be uninterested in a discourse or narration.
